subject: Mobile Development
title: Will Two Stores Remain?
description: One-minute skill: Will Two Stores Remain?.

hook.text: For over a decade, two app stores have dominated. Will it always be this way?

buildup.text: Regulation, alternative stores, and PWAs are chipping away at the duopoly.

discovery.text: But network effects are powerful. Users stick with familiar stores and payment methods.

twist.text: Even in Europe with the DMA, most users will likely never use an alternative store.

climax.text: The duopoly may loosen at the edges but likely won't collapse. Habits are hard to break.

punchline.text: Two stores may bend, but they won't break.

quiz.question: Why might the app store duopoly persist despite regulation?
options: Network effects and user habits are very strong
